extDescription.message: Stops multiple video services on tab unfocus and continues on focus

autopause.description: Enable auto pause when switching tabs

muteVideo.description: Enable muting video instead of pausing

blockAutoplay.description: Prevent videos from starting before the user interacts with the page

prioritizeActiveTabMedia.message: Prioritize media in the active tab
prioritizeActiveTabMedia.description: Pause other tabs' media and resume the previous source when the current source stops.

idlePauseMinutes.description: Idle timeout in minutes; 0 disables automatic idle pause.

quietHours.description: Schedule a daily pause interval using local clock time.

quietHoursStart.description: Local time at which quiet hours begin.

quietHoursEnd.description: Local time at which quiet hours end.

disableAutoplayNext.message: Stop videos from autoplaying the next video

sleepTimerStart.description: Start a timer to pause media.

sleepTimerDuration.description: Select how many minutes until media is paused.

sleepTimerSet.message: Sleep timer set: pausing videos in $1 minutes
sleepTimerSet.description: Status shown while the timer is active.

sleepTimerFailed.message: Could not set the sleep timer
sleepTimerFailed.description: Error shown when the timer cannot be changed.

autoresume.message: Resume video when returning to tab
autoresume.description: Enable auto resume when returning to tab

focuspause.message: Pause video when browser loses focus
focuspause.description: Enable auto pause when browser window loses focus

focusresume.message: Resume video when browser gains focus
focusresume.description: Enable auto resume when browser window gains focus

disabledTabs.description: Disable extension for the current tab

disableOnFullscreen.description: Disable extension when video is in fullscreen mode

lockpause.message: Pause video when computer is locked
lockpause.description: Enable auto pause when computer is locked

lockresume.message: Resume video when computer is unlocked
lockresume.description: Enable auto resume when computer is unlocked

scrollpause.message: Pause video when scrolled out of view
scrollpause.description: Enable auto pause when video is scrolled out of viewport

singleVideoPlayback.message: Play only the most visible video
singleVideoPlayback.description: Keep only the video with the largest visible area playing on a page

cursorTracking.message: Pause when cursor leaves browser window
cursorTracking.description: Enable cursor tracking to pause when cursor leaves window

peekMode.message: Keep playing while the pointer is over the video
peekMode.description: Keep a hovered video playing when focus changes.

hotkeysDescription.message: You can configure hotkeys in the Extensions menu

reportSite.description: Report a site where playback control does not work.

reportSiteDescription.message: Opens a report draft with the site origin and browser; nothing is sent unless you submit it.
reportSiteDescription.description: Privacy note for the report link.

importSettings.description: Import settings from a JSON file.

settingsImportFailed.message: Could not import settings. Check the JSON file.

profileName.description: Name for a saved settings profile.

saveProfile.description: Save current settings to a profile.

commandToggleTab.description: Command description for toggling on active tab

commandSpeedUp.description: Command description for increasing playback speed

commandSpeedDown.description: Command description for decreasing playback speed

commandSpeedReset.description: Command description for resetting playback speed

pipTitle.description: Title text for the PiP button

onboardingIntro.message: Videos pause when you switch tabs, scroll away, or lock your device and resume when you return.

onboardingPin.message: Pin the extension to your toolbar for quick access.
onboardingPin.description: Welcome page reminder to pin the extension

onboardingOptions.description: Welcome page button to open settings

statsSummary.message: $1 pauses · $2 resumes · $3 autoplay blocks · $4 min of playback prevented

presetStudyDescription.message: Pauses and resumes when you switch tabs or windows, then rewinds 5 seconds.
presetStudyDescription.description: Explanation shown for the study preset

presetMusicDescription.message: Keeps playback going when you switch tabs or windows or lock your device.
presetMusicDescription.description: Explanation shown for the music preset

presetBingeDescription.message: Pauses and resumes on tab changes and device lock; ignores focus changes and disables itself in fullscreen.
presetBingeDescription.description: Explanation shown for the binge preset

presetSaverDescription.message: Pauses on tab changes, focus loss, device lock, or when video scrolls out of view; blocks autoplay and does not auto-resume.
presetSaverDescription.description: Explanation shown for the battery saver preset

rewindSeconds.description: Amount of time to rewind after automatic resume

liveStreamMute.message: Mute live streams instead of pausing
liveStreamMute.description: Mute live videos when an automatic pause would occur

muteDuringAds.message: Mute during ads, then pause when they end
muteDuringAds.description: Mute media while a recognized ad is playing

overlayDragHandle.description: Accessible label for the draggable overlay handle

overlaySiteOn.description: Site is enabled in the overlay

overlaySiteOff.description: Site is disabled in the overlay

pinCurrentTab.description: Action to pin playback in the current tab

unpinCurrentTab.description: Action to remove the current tab pin

pinFailure.message: Could not update the tab pin.
pinFailure.description: Failure status for tab pin changes

commandTogglePin.message: Toggle keep-playing pin for the active tab
commandTogglePin.description: Keyboard command for the temporary tab pin

siteRuleIntro.message: Configure an individual site without changing global settings.

onlyConfiguredSites.description: Only run the extension on sites with an enabled rule

siteRuleEnabled.message: Enable the extension on this site
siteRuleEnabled.description: Enable or disable the extension for a site

playbackSpeed.message: Playback speed (0 = use the site’s speed)
playbackSpeed.description: Global and per-site playback speed; zero leaves the current site speed unchanged

siteSettingsTitle.description: Title for the per-site settings view

siteSettingsBack.description: Button that returns to global settings

siteSettingsIntro.message: These settings apply only to this site. Leave a setting on its global value unless you customize it.

siteRuleAdd.description: Create a per-site settings rule for the active site

siteRuleCustomize.description: Control to customize a setting for one site

contentShortcutsDescription.message: Shortcuts work while the page is focused. Leave a key blank to disable an action.

contentShortcutsConflict.message: Each action must use a different key.

shortcutFrameUnavailable.message: This video frame cannot be captured (it may be protected).

shortcutActionUnsupported.message: This action is not supported for the current video.

autoPipOnTabSwitch.message: Open video in Picture-in-Picture when switching tabs

pauseOnLowBattery.message: Pause background videos when battery is low

pauseOnLowBatteryDescription.message: Uses the browser Battery Status API when available. Videos resume when the tab becomes active or charging begins.

pauseAtEnd.message: Stop automatic playback of the next video at the end

pauseAtEndNotice.message: Automatic playback of the next video was stopped.

pauseOnAudioOutputDisconnect.message: Pause videos when an audio output disconnects

pauseOnAudioOutputDisconnectDescription.message: Best effort: supported browsers pause when a previously available audio output disappears.

diagnosticsDescription.message: Copies browser details and settings to your clipboard. Nothing is sent automatically.

settingsSaveFailed.message: Could not save settings. Check that browser sync storage is available.

onboardingFeatures.description: Accessible name for the onboarding feature list.

disableOnFullscreenDescription.message: Videos are not paused or muted automatically while a video is in fullscreen.

sleepTimerDescription.message: Pauses videos in every tab when the selected time has passed.
sleepTimerDescription.description: Tooltip for the sleep timer button.

singleVideoPlaybackDescription.message: When several videos on a page play at once, only the most visible one keeps playing.
singleVideoPlaybackDescription.description: Tooltip for the single video playback setting.

cursorTrackingDescription.message: Pauses when the pointer reaches the edge of the window and resumes when it returns.
cursorTrackingDescription.description: Tooltip for the cursor tracking setting.

peekModeDescription.message: When focus pausing is on, a video keeps playing while the pointer is over it.
peekModeDescription.description: Tooltip for the peek mode setting.

manualPauseDescription.message: Videos you pause yourself stay paused when you return to the tab.
manualPauseDescription.description: Tooltip for the manual pause setting.

allowAudioDescription.message: Audio-only players, such as music and podcasts, keep playing. Turn off to pause them too.
allowAudioDescription.description: Tooltip for the audio-only playback setting.

blockAutoplayDescription.message: Videos cannot start on their own until you click or press a key on the page.
blockAutoplayDescription.description: Tooltip for the autoplay blocking setting.

disableAutoplayNextDescription.message: Turns off the player's autoplay toggle and blocks automatic jumps to the next video.
disableAutoplayNextDescription.description: Tooltip for the next-video autoplay setting.

pauseAtEndDescription.message: When a video ends, the next video that starts on its own is paused.

liveStreamMuteDescription.message: Live streams are muted instead of paused so they stay live.
liveStreamMuteDescription.description: Tooltip for the live stream setting.

muteDuringAdsDescription.message: If an ad is playing, the video is muted until the ad ends and then paused.
muteDuringAdsDescription.description: Tooltip for the ad muting setting.

prioritizeActiveTabMediaDescription.message: Controls playback across tabs, not videos on the same page. Media in the active tab pauses media in other tabs; the previous tab resumes when it stops.
prioritizeActiveTabMediaDescription.description: Tooltip for prioritizing media across tabs.

onlyConfiguredSitesDescription.message: The extension runs only on sites listed below with the extension enabled.

speedToast.description: On-page notice after changing playback speed. $1 is the new speed.

overlayDragHandleHint.message: Drag, or use the arrow keys, to move these controls
overlayDragHandleHint.description: Tooltip for the handle that moves the on-video controls.

overlaySpeed.description: Tooltip for the playback speed shown in the on-video controls.

contentShortcutKeys.description: Label for customizing in-page shortcut keys for a site.
